info.name: PharmAssist - Auth through the gateway
info.description:
Functional and negative tests for the auth endpoints, called through the API gateway (base_url).

See tests/postman/README.md.

NOTE: email verification with the 6-digit code (POST /auth/verify-email) is NOT tested here. The code is only written to the local identity-service log (APP_ENV=local) and no email is sent yet, so a collection cannot read it. That path is covered by the identity-service PHPUnit tests.

Order matters: 01 Auth, 02 Negative, then 99 Rate limit last. The login limit is 10 per minute per IP and this whole collection counts toward it, so wait 60 seconds between runs.

Secrets: the seeded password is NOT stored in any file. Supply it with --env-var "seed_password=<password>" or paste it into the environment in Postman.
